steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Unfortunately, the enemy has retreated into a storm zone covered by a chaotic Mania field to evade pursuit. However, there is some positive news—the severe sandstorms that persisted for nearly a month have finally weakened, allowing us to enter the storm zone and continue tracking them.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Luck favors you, Chief.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Luck...? But I recall that one of Aurum Secretum's functions is to adjust the Mania field on a large scale, guiding the movement of the Tide of Ashes...

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: Target area secured! The enemy is cornered in the eastern section of the camp, still heavily armed.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: Chief, Advisor Campbell remains in hostile custody, being held hostage by the rebels. We can't risk a direct assault.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: Copy that. Please be careful!
The Paradeisos triangle, small and silent, floats through the area, probing every corner to find a path. In moments, it unravels a route that leads deeper inside.

You step inside and find the corpses of several Outlanders strewn across the floor. Their bodies have been ravaged by corruption, the damage so severe that it's impossible to tell whether they were Fraser officials or the extremists who took them hostage.
Amidst the ruins, you at last come face to face with the "kidnapped" representative. He stands unnervingly calm amid the devastation, a faint smile playing on his lips, his garments immaculate.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: It's been a while, Chief ${PlayerName}. I heard the commotion at the closing ceremony has been settled. Did you come all this way to rescue me?
You don't answer. Instead, you walk toward him and draw your gun.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, stay calm. Let's find out what really happened first.

You draw your gun and fire several shots at him, but before the bullets can find their mark, the contamination at his feet writhes upward. The shots strike nothing but twisting darkness, and Adelaide stands untouched.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: See? This is much faster. Now the real question is—how did this guy pass the Sinner inspection? Where did his power come from?
Schorl performs a quick scan.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: He is certainly not a Sinner. Even in that moment just now, he did not activate any internal power.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...Could this be some unknown kind of Outland technology? The Mania field is interfering with communications. I can't contact headquarters or synchronize analysis data.
Adelaide doesn't answer. He just smiles at you.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: How rare to see you so unsettled, Chief. What troubles you? Wasn't today's victory over the Outland extremists worthy of celebration?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Ah, I see now. This is about that dancer. She went to the closing ceremony, didn't she? Is she dead? Did you personally see to it?
You look directly into his eyes and respond, each word measured and deliberate.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You brought her to the Great Expo. She was obsessed with the closing ceremony because she thought FAC was the former DisCity military—the ones who started the war—and she was hellbent on revenge... And you're the one who put it all in her head, aren't you?
He smiles resignedly.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Heh... Chief, surely you of all people understand. You oversaw the treatment plan—you must have known Jasmine was beyond recovery. Years of unrelenting contamination, the ravages of war... her mind was already fractured beyond salvation.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: As a civilian, she was never bound by that weapon's influence—no indiscriminate slaughter, no blind obedience. She journeyed alone to WhiteSands, selecting her targets with purpose... Nothing short of a miracle, really. I merely offered my assistance. After all, who wouldn't wish to see such a dream realized?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: What a shame. Had there been no war—had DisCity never forged those blades—she might have remained a clever, carefree dancer. You know her far better than I... don't you?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, don't debate morality with the enemy. His only intent is to sway you. Stay composed and ready yourself for battle.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand... but this bastard has no right to say a word about them to me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Jelena, Jasmine, and all those who attacked the closing ceremony. You knew those people didn't stand a chance. You knew their deaths wouldn't change a thing. But you pushed them toward revenge anyway.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You deliberately fed their information to DisCity, selling them out just to gain DisCity's trust. All for that absurd plan of yours. You'd do anything to get Nirvana's technology, wouldn't you?
You raise your gun.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Both you and Fraser will pay for this.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: You seek to hold Fraser accountable? Consider the cost—such a path would bring ruin to both our city-states.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: The Fraser delegation arrived with intelligence, Aurum Secretum, and sincere intentions for peace. They have indirectly fueled Eastside's booming stock market, allowing prosperity to spread. Who could doubt the virtue of such an outcome?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Both DisCity and Fraser have their advocates for unification—Nirvana on one side, Fraser's pro-DisCity faction on the other. It is only among the lower classes that hatred obscures reason. The enlightened elites, however, have long transcended such... parochial loyalties.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Consider this: Mutual suspicion breeds only war, while cooperation revitalizes resources—enough to harvest the world itself. Which path do you suppose people will choose? In the end, they will believe what they wish to believe.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: The contract shall be signed—Nirvana has no recourse but compliance. Let us celebrate the union of the two great city-states and the dawn of a new era. And now... allow me to present a shared adversary, one to fortify the bonds between you all.
[CG: Handshake]
He extends his hand toward you—this time with his left hand—his face twisted into an abyssal smile, brimming with boundless malice.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: I am Adelaide Campbell—collaborator with the Underground, architect of the Outlands' corruption, the hand that twisted Aurum Secretum and delivered sinister power to vengeful souls. And now... I intend to drive a wedge between DisCity and Fraser.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Am I not what you've been seeking all along?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You're a saboteur sent by the Underground?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Or are you throwing yourself under the bus just to clear Fraser's name in all this? Like how you sold out those Outlanders who came for revenge?
He flashes an approving smile at you.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Fraser is far too shrewd to risk open war with DisCity. The Senate does not act rashly, nor would they be so careless as to leave you evidence, unless...

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: DisCity has grown so weak it's no longer a threat. Crushing you would demand so little effort, so... why not indulge?
[Small CG 2]
A bright red mark flares to life on his hand. In the next breath, a gust of contamination surges toward you. With lightning speed, Schorl throws itself in front of you and your squad.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Fall back!

It deploys a small barrier field to protect you all, but in doing so, fails to avoid a strange spike hidden within the storm. The spike collides with Schorl's outer shell, emitting an eerie resonance. Then, from within the perfect triangle, you hear a disturbing crackle of rogue electrical currents.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ——*%%@#¥&——interference¥#@&——data corrupted——storage damaged————Chi**%¥——ef——maintain... ra**￥#%...tionality...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's wrong?! Answer me!

But this is your final exchange. Like a failing system, its barrier shudders and flickers before collapsing entirely—forced into a desperate reboot. Now, it can barely sustain its most fundamental function: shielding you, and only you, at close range. From this moment onward, the black triangle that has buzzed incessantly at your side for nearly two weeks falls utterly silent.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Signal interference... data corruption... This isn't Aurum Secretum's power. Don't tell me...
[Flash briefly: Moore Small CG]
[Back to Small CG 2]

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Your internal vulnerability is plain to see. Competing interests paralyze progress, each faction too busy guarding its own spoils to notice the rot. Why waste bullets when greed is enough to do most of the work? Today's DisCity is truly riddled with flaws—decayed and fragile.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Now then, I'd like to proceed with another test... I'm most curious to witness the true measure of your worth—as DisCity's "secret weapon."
[Power Eruption CG]

The Mania seeping from his left hand suddenly blooms into a flower. The contamination swells, twisting and writhing as it expands, weaving together before finally coalescing into several monstrous abominations. You know this aura—
Constrained by Aurum Secretum devices, they are several ferocious Apostles of Ashes.
